blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) and the Maritime Industry Authority (Marina) are planning to pilot test fully electric and hybrid ferries on select routes in the country to reduce carbon emissions and fuel costs. According to Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez on Thursday, the initiative aims to harness the hybrid technology to benefit passengers, shipowners, and the environment. “Kaya nitong mabawasan ang konsumo ng fuel, carbon emissions, at gastos sa operasyon ng mga vessels.
